evals.name: E-commerce Site (Clothing)
evals.prompt: Extract all brand names from https://www.asos.com/men/a-to-z-of-brands/ and provide them as a JSON list with source context.
evals.expected_output: A JSON list containing brands like 'Adidas', 'Nike', 'ASOS Design', etc., with contextual notes.

evals.name: Tech Directory
evals.prompt: List the brands featured on https://www.techradar.com/news/computing/pc/best-laptop-brands-1317511 and include where they were mentioned.
evals.expected_output: A list of laptop brands (e.g., Apple, HP, Dell) extracted from the article content.

evals.name: Simplified Mock Page
evals.prompt: Extract brands from a local HTML file containing a list of partners.
evals.expected_output: Brand names extracted from the local file content.
